_about: The Frostline as a zone plan (Claude A's world-building stream, 11 Nov), from docs/vision/regions/home-valley-frostline-brackens.md (the Col hut threshold, the Frostline lip, the tarn, the High Fells, the ibex rocks) and docs/vision/regions/valley-plan.md (the Col Path leaves the valley northwards from the woodland's T2 terrace; the Frostline's foot meets the valley along y 2304). It is built in the world editor's format: its ground, pieces, actors, spawns and doors are the kit plan game/kit/zones/frostline.json, and game/tools/kit_zone.gd turns that into game/zones/frostline/frostline.tscn (docs/world-editor.md). This file holds what the kit plan does not: where the zone sits on the world canvas, why each place is where it is, which quest binding each actor carries, what is gated and why, and the named states `--stage` sets (game.gd apply_stage). World px, local to the zone, origin at its top-left (one cell 8 px; the kit plan's texels are 3 to the px). `kit_plan` marks it a kit zone, so game/tools/gen_blockout.py skips it (no `art` key: that names the native town and vault painters, scripts/art/native/check.py). Smallest complete: two screens, the Col hut and the tarn brought closer together than the brief's 450 px so the first chapter plays on them.

kit.why: every piece is a candidate of the library gate (docs/world-editor.md, 'The library gate'): the zone stays a lab, out of data/zones.json, until Matt approves the Frostline set

places.why: the Col Path climbs in from the woodland's north edge (the south door), past the hut, by one switchback to the tarn's shore; trodden snow two cells wide
the threshold of the brief's section 3 (6290, 2350): the hut warden's bothy, its door on the trod, smoke from the stove; the warden stands at the door
Snowmelt Lake's tarn (6200, 1800), the Sleepwater's source; ringed with snow, nothing stands in it
the ice-cutter's sledge drawn up on the east shore, where the ice is cut for Cogsworth
the High Fells' bench past the boulder field (the warden's own words): moraine and snowy boulders, the shardstruck ibex's camp; reached over the snow from the trod's top
the brief's 'fallen climbers' camp beside the path': a cold fire ring by the trod
the north edge: scree and boulders thickening into the headwall (section 6); the pines thicken on the west and east shoulders

people.speaker: hut_warden
people.why: Bread for the Col hut (step warden), The ring is shut (start and report), Under the snout (start), A cup by the stove, A ring of our own. No cast art yet: she speaks from the hut's door

people.speaker: ice_cutter
people.why: Under the snout (step cutter); her default lines otherwise. No cast art yet: she speaks from her sledge

camps.why: The ring is shut (step fells): two rushers and a shooter of Codex's slice enemies in the woodland creatures' looks (enemies/creature_dresser.gd, no den) until the ibex are drawn. The scene's root is a plain node holding the Camp, so the kit plan holds it as a `scene` actor and the editor's export keeps it

spawns.why: where the woodland's north door brings the player in (its spawn on this side)

doors.why: down the Col Path to the woodland. The woodland has no 'frostline' spawn and no north door yet (Claude A sequences them after #476): until then this door lands at the woodland's first spawn (world/zone.gd spawn_position)

gated.why: starts with Moss only while zone_built:frostline holds, so it waits for this zone to be in data/zones.json; its first step, the shard crows at the ridge col (camp:col_crows), belongs on the Col Path below this zone, on the woodland's side of the door, with that door

needs the ice caves (enter:ice_caves, camp:ice_caves_rooms, camp:rime_wyrm, Tam, the frost shard), which are not built: its start now also waits for zone_built:ice_caves, as the bread waits for the Frostline, so it cannot start and then wait on rooms that do not exist

stages.why: the bread's climb done: the warden waits for her loaf
the ibex freed: the High Fells quiet
